name: Playwright headless Chromium system dependencies
description: Installs the shared libraries and fonts that Playwright's headless Chromium needs, with package names resolved per distribution (the 64-bit time_t transition renamed six of them). Does NOT install Playwright or any browser -- run 'playwright install chromium' in the project. Requires runArgs ['--ipc=host'] in the project, or chromium crashes on the default 64MB /dev/shm.
